shape: 3-portal sprawling arena (S + W + E gates) with two super-hubs (south + center)
description: Three-portal sprawl with two super-hub anchors. SOUTH super-hub (e02rc1, 4-way) joins south_gate + west chain top (0emaba) + south_inner clique (i56a2j + e6diuf). CENTER super-hub (i56a2j, 4-way) fans south to a south clique (zr1xue + dxy3iz + east_gate), west to rlezog (then NW cluster), and north to e6diuf. The west cluster (kec5v4) is a 4-way W-side dispatcher reaching spawn_west, rlezog, 3ch2q6, and 6i4wox. East cluster has 2 pockets (n8owd8, xqps49) off dxy3iz.

portals.south: spawn_south at (-13.95, 24.14) — gate on the south (high-Z) side, west column
portals.west: spawn_west at (-22.89, -15.77) — gate on the west (low-X) side
portals.east: spawn_east at (22.64, 0.86) — gate on the east (high-X) side, near midline

anchors.description: SW chain top - bridge to center (matches 0emaba)
south clique east / east entry (matches dxy3iz)

traversalNotes: Direct S→E: spawn_south → south_inner → center → s_clique_e → spawn_east. 4 hops.
Direct S→W: spawn_south → south_inner → sw_chain_t → center → c_w_step → west_inner → spawn_west. 6 hops.
Direct W→E: spawn_west → west_inner → c_w_step → center → s_clique_e → spawn_east. 5 hops.
DISPATCH: center (i56a2j) is the canonical 4-way router; south_inner + west_inner are entry super-hubs.
WEST CLIQUE: west_inner + c_w_step + w_mid + c_n form a 4-anchor clique near the west gate.
Two east pockets (se_pocket, e_pocket) off s_clique_e — corner objectives.
